description: Connect a visitor with the agent's staff: hand the chat to a person or leave a message staff can review and follow up.
migration_note: Compiled Rust adapter storing staff messages in the agent plane. Message review is staff-only (owner or member) in addition to capability-ladder grants. request_human reuses the shared-chat help request and requires the agent's help policy. Deployment requires rebuilding both API and loop.
skill_summary: Hand the chat to staff or leave them a message; staff review messages.
